1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.JunctionOrder

5 /-! All incident radial triangles at a nonvertex junction are chosen at
6 once, in one common coordinate frame and with their actual route labels.
7 This is geometric assembly data, not yet a quotient cut surface.
8 -/
9 
10 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
11 
12 open Real Set
13 
14 /-- The two actual radial developments of one incident edge, placed and labelled. -/
15 structure IncidentTriangles {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body}
16     (T : P.CutLocusTree a) {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v)
17     (chart : P.CutVoronoiChart a (T.vertexTarget u)) (angle : ℝ) extends CutEdgeTriangles T edge where
18   motion : Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane
19   at_junction : motion model.left = chart.origin
20   at_neighbor : motion model.right = chart.origin + dist (u : Space) (v : Space) • direction angle
21   first_label : chart.Represents (motion model.first) (first 0)
22   second_label : chart.Represents (motion model.second) (second 0)
23 
24 /-- A finite junction fan retains all actual strips and their common-chart placements. -/
25 structure JunctionFan {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body}
26     (T : P.CutLocusTree a) (u : T.vertices) where
27   order : JunctionOrder T u
28   triangles : ∀ m : circularGapMidpoints order.angles order.first order.last,
29     IncidentTriangles T (order.neighbors m).property order.chart m
30 
31 namespace SixVertexGraph
32 
33 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
34   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
35     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
36 
37 include graph small_faces in
38 /-- Simultaneous incident-edge developments with one circular order and
39 one chart. Every triangle retains its original surface parametrization. -/
40 theorem exists_junction_fan (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
41     (u : T.vertices) (not_vertex : (u : Space) ∉ P.vertices) : Nonempty (JunctionFan T u) := by
42   classical
43   obtain ⟨order⟩ := graph.exists_junction_order small_faces a T u not_vertex
44   have developments (m : circularGapMidpoints order.angles order.first order.last) :
45       Nonempty (IncidentTriangles T (order.neighbors m).property order.chart m) := by
46     let v := (order.neighbors m).val
47     let edge : T.graph.Adj u v := (order.neighbors m).property
48     obtain ⟨S⟩ := graph.exists_cut_edge_strips small_faces a T edge
49     obtain ⟨M, first, second, agrees, member, ⟨D⟩, ⟨E⟩⟩ :=
50       graph.exists_cut_edge_triangle_developments small_faces a T edge S
51     obtain ⟨α, β, ordered, one_turn, midpoint, _, _, first_source, second_source, empty_gap⟩ :=
52       circular_midpoint_gap order.sites order.angles order.increasing order.bounds order.chart.origin
53         (P.surfaceDist a (T.vertexTarget u)) order.position order.first order.last
54         order.at_first order.at_last order.two m.property
55     have on_ray (ρ : ℝ) (hr : ρ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) order.radius) :
56         order.chart.map (order.chart.origin + ρ • direction ((α + β) / 2)) ∈
57           openSegment ℝ (T.vertexTarget u : Space) (v : Space) := by
58       rw [← midpoint]
59       exact order.rays m ρ hr
60     obtain ⟨motion, at_junction, at_neighbor, first_label, second_label⟩ :=
61       order.chart.incident_placement_with_routes graph small_faces T edge rfl not_vertex
62         M S first second agrees member ordered one_turn first_source second_source empty_gap
63         order.radius_positive on_ray
64     refine ⟨⟨⟨S, M, first, second, agrees, member, D, E⟩, motion, at_junction, ?_,
65       first_label, second_label⟩⟩
66     simpa only [← midpoint] using at_neighbor
67   exact ⟨⟨order, fun m => Classical.choice (developments m)⟩⟩
68 
69 end SixVertexGraph
70 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
